summary: No winner talks about how many votes or by what margin.
realLife: All six victory speeches skip the margin; the win is called a mandate or a message instead.

inGame: the contest result row has the margin; the rule is that the speech does not say it (no figures in speeches)

turns.way: A narrow win is named as narrow, in words.
turns.pulledBy: a margin under a few points; a humble speaker
turns.writes: the line says the race was close, never a number

turns.way: A landslide is named as a mandate.
turns.pulledBy: a wide margin; an ambitious speaker
turns.writes: the line says the voters spoke clearly
